submission.title: Nexivarin 10 mg Film-Coated Tablets — Original New Drug Application

receiverOrganization.name: U.S. Food and Drug Administration — Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER)

submissionUnit.title: Sequence 0000 — Original NDA Submission
submissionUnit.text: Original New Drug Application for Nexivarin 10 mg Film-Coated Tablets (NDA123456, Sequence 0000), submitted pursuant to 21 CFR 314.50 for the proposed indications of hypertension and stable angina pectoris. This sequence constitutes the complete initial filing and establishes the baseline eCTD lifecycle for NDA123456.

document.title: Transmittal Cover Letter — Nexivarin 10 mg Tablets NDA123456
document.desc: Transmittal cover letter to the FDA summarising the scope of the original NDA submission, the drug product identity, and the enclosed documentation. Certifies completeness of the filing per 21 CFR 314.50.

document.title: FDA Form 1571 — IND/NDA Application Form
document.desc: Completed FDA Form 1571 constituting the official application form for NDA123456. Contains applicant information, proposed indications, regulatory history cross-references, and sponsor certifications required under 21 CFR 314.50(a).

document.title: Proposed Prescribing Information — Nexivarin 10 mg Film-Coated Tablets
document.desc: Draft prescribing information (Package Insert) including Highlights of Prescribing Information, Full Prescribing Information, and Patient Counselling Information, prepared in accordance with 21 CFR 201.56 and 201.57 (Physician Labeling Rule format).

document.title: Patent Certifications — NDA123456 Nexivarin
document.desc: Documentation of all listed patents in the FDA Orange Book claiming the drug substance, drug product, or approved use, with applicable Paragraph III or IV certifications per 21 CFR 314.50(i).

document.title: Environmental Assessment — Nexivarin 10 mg Tablets
document.desc: Environmental assessment prepared per 21 CFR Part 25 evaluating potential environmental impact of approval and commercialisation of Nexivarin, with justification for categorical exclusion.

section.title: Module 2 — Common Technical Document Summaries and Overviews
2.2 — Introduction to the Common Technical Document

document.title: Introduction to the Common Technical Document — Nexivarin NDA123456
document.desc: Brief CTD introduction describing the overall dossier structure, drug development programme background, and strategic rationale for the selected dosage form and target patient population.

document.title: Quality Overall Summary — Nexivarin 10 mg Film-Coated Tablets
document.desc: Integrated narrative quality summary covering drug substance and drug product: manufacturing overview, control strategy, key quality attributes, and BCS classification supporting the proposed dissolution specification.

document.title: Nonclinical Overview — Nexivarin
document.desc: Integrated nonclinical overview interpreting pharmacology, pharmacokinetics, and toxicology study results; identifies NOAELs, safety margins relative to clinical exposure, and any nonclinical signals requiring clinical monitoring per ICH M4S.

document.title: Clinical Overview — Nexivarin Development Programme
document.desc: Critical appraisal of the clinical development programme integrating Phase I–III efficacy and safety findings, benefit–risk assessment, and regulatory strategy supporting the proposed indication per ICH M4E.

section.title: Module 3 — Quality: Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls

document.title: Nexivarin API — Nomenclature, Structure, and Physicochemical Properties
document.desc: INN/USAN designation, CAS number, molecular formula and weight, structural formula, stereochemistry, physicochemical properties, and general pharmacopoeial classification for Nexivarin.

document.title: Nexivarin API — Manufacturer Details, Synthetic Route, and Process Validation
document.desc: Manufacturer details, synthetic route description, batch formula, in-process controls, and process validation summary demonstrating consistent production of Nexivarin API meeting all specifications.

section.title: 3.2.S.4 — Control of Drug Substance (Specification and Methods)

document.title: Nexivarin API — Specification, Analytical Methods, and Batch Data
document.desc: Specification with acceptance criteria for identity, assay, related substances, residual solvents, heavy metals, and microbiological quality; analytical method descriptions, validation summaries, and batch analysis data supporting the proposed specification.

document.title: Nexivarin API — ICH Q1A(R2) Stability Data and Retest Period
document.desc: ICH Q1A(R2) stability data under long-term (25 °C/60% RH), accelerated (40 °C/75% RH), and stress conditions; proposed retest period; post-approval stability protocol and commitment.

document.title: Nexivarin 10 mg Tablets — Pharmaceutical Development Report
document.desc: Formulation development history, excipient selection and functional roles, BCS classification, dissolution method development, and compatibility studies supporting the commercial formulation per ICH Q8.

document.title: Nexivarin 10 mg Tablets — Manufacturing Process and Process Validation
document.desc: Manufacturer and packaging site details, batch formula (clinical and commercial scale), manufacturing process description (wet granulation, compression, film coating, packaging), critical process parameters, in-process controls, and commercial-scale process validation data.

document.title: Nexivarin 10 mg Tablets — ICH Q1A(R2) Stability Data and Shelf Life Proposal
document.desc: Stability data for the proposed commercial packaging (HDPE bottle and alu/alu blister); photostability per ICH Q1B; proposed 24-month shelf life; post-approval stability commitment and protocol.

document.title: Nexivarin — Primary Pharmacodynamics: Receptor Binding, Mechanism of Action, and In Vivo Efficacy
document.desc: In vitro and in vivo studies: L-type VGCC binding affinity and selectivity, mechanism of action, and functional antihypertensive efficacy in isolated tissue and conscious animal models.

document.title: Nexivarin — ICH S7A/S7B Core Battery Safety Pharmacology Studies
document.desc: Core battery per ICH S7A/S7B: hERG inhibition and in vivo QTc telemetry, CNS Irwin test, and respiratory function; supplemental renal safety study evaluating urinary electrolyte excretion. GLP.

document.title: Nexivarin — 28-Day and 90-Day Oral Repeat-Dose Toxicity Studies (Rat and Dog), GLP
document.desc: GLP-compliant 28-day and 90-day rat studies and 90-day dog study: clinical observations, body weight, food consumption, clinical pathology, organ weights, macroscopic and microscopic pathology, NOAEL determination, and toxicokinetics.

document.title: Nexivarin — ICH S2(R1) Genotoxicity Battery (Ames, CA, Mouse MN), GLP
document.desc: ICH S2(R1) standard battery: Ames bacterial reverse mutation assay, in vitro mammalian chromosomal aberration (CHO cells), and in vivo mouse micronucleus test. ICH M7 TTC interpretation included.

code.displayName: 5.2 Tabular Listing of All Clinical Studies

section.title: 5.2 — Tabular Listing of All Clinical Studies

document.title: Nexivarin — Tabular Listing of All Clinical Studies
document.desc: Comprehensive tabular listing of all Phase I–III clinical studies: identifiers, phase, design, population, treatment arms, primary endpoints, enrolment numbers, and cross-references to Section 5.3.

code.displayName: 5.3.4.2 Pivotal Phase III Clinical Study Report

section.title: 5.3.4.2 — Phase III Pivotal Study: NXV-301 Full Clinical Study Report

document.title: Study NXV-301 CSR — Randomised, Double-Blind, Placebo-Controlled Phase III Trial of Nexivarin 10 mg in Hypertension
document.desc: Full CSR for Study NXV-301 (ICH E3 format): 52-week, randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, multicentre Phase III trial, n=1,240, mild-to-moderate hypertension. Primary endpoint: change from baseline in seated SBP at Week 12. GCP ICH E6(R2) compliant.

document.title: Integrated Summary of Safety — Nexivarin Phase II/III Pool (n ≈ 2,400)
document.desc: Pooled ISS (Phase II/III, n ≈ 2,400): exposure data, TEAEs, SAEs, deaths, discontinuations, laboratory abnormalities, vital signs, ECG findings, and special populations; benefit–risk context for proposed prescribing information.

document.title: Literature References — NDA123456 Nexivarin Modules 2–5
document.desc: Compiled bibliography cited throughout Modules 2–5: peer-reviewed journal articles, FDA/ICH guidance documents, pharmacopoeial monographs, and WHO/ICH technical reports relevant to Nexivarin's pharmacology, toxicology, and clinical profile.
